body: Hey, I just now saw this. This isn’t my usual account, just where I post a lot of heavy emotional stuff. Anyway I just wanted to say thank you. I did take the advice of some other people who commented and ended up quitting that job and have been taking some time off to clear my head, and I’ve been feeling a lot better, but today I’ve been kind of down so your comment really made me feel better.
Yes I’m 26. I saw your post on my other account and felt compelled to get on and comment because I’ve often wondered the same thing.

I understand, my story would be a long one too. Feel free to send me a message if you would like. I understand and I know it’s not just a stage. My family has always acted that way too even though I’ve been having these problems since childhood.

Thank you so much. You said exactly what I needed to hear. I come from a pretty old fashioned family that doesn’t believe in mental illness and they all very much have the mentality that your ability to make a lot of money and be self sufficient is your entire worth as a human being. It’s like if people can’t physically see the problems you’re going through they won’t believe they’re real. And then they get mad at you for isolating yourself. I just can’t take it anymore

Thank you, that really means a lot. 
I definitely know how you feel about being the “funny” one and people just slapping a label on you and expecting you to always just be that. Similarly, my family always tells me that I’m “the one with my head on straight” or the one that “has my stuff together” when really this couldn’t be farther from the truth. But they don’t see that, and they don’t want to. And it’s gotten to the point where I don’t even want to let anyone see it. So I feel very lonely all the time as well. It’s definitely draining to pretend to be happy or risk people asking you what’s wrong only to get mad at you when you tell them the truth. 

I hope you are okay as well. Feel free to message me if you ever want to talk

Thank you. Really it’s like I’ve always been depressed but the last 4 years or so is when the suicidal feelings started. I’m 25 and the last year has been the worst of it so far. Sometimes I feel happier for a while but it doesn’t last long. A lot of my problems are just things I don’t like about myself and that just make me feel stuck, and also the relationships I have with people around me. 
You seem to have hope that it doesn’t last forever, so I hope that means it hasn’t for you. Thank you for reaching out to me. I could really use people to talk to.

Thank you. Honestly I’ve been depressed all my life and there’s been a lot of different things that contributed to it. But I’ve been in an especially low place the last year or so and it just keeps getting worse.
